EG is assumed to be used in the second parameterization, while√ the bounds for the remaining algorithms apply to both parameterizations (since G2 D2 = Ω( T ) in both cases). √ EG is the only algorithm that provides a meaningful bound of order O( T log T ), as shown in Appendix A. All the other bounds are vacuous (linear in T or worse). This fact does not completely rule out these algorithms since we do not know a priori whether their bounds are tight in the worst case for isotonic regression.
